FORTIS HEALTHCARE LIMITED
DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL SURGERY
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient Name: Meera Nambiar                UHID: FH-44019
Age: 35 Yrs    Gender: Female             DOA: 05/02/2024
Consultant: Dr. Radhika Sharma            DOD: 08/02/2024

CLINICAL SUMMARY
Patient presented with acute cholecystitis, right upper quadrant pain, and nausea.

FINAL DIAGNOSIS
Symptomatic Cholelithiasis with Acute Cholecystitis.

TREATMENT GIVEN
Elective Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy performed under general anesthesia on 06/02/2024. Uneventful recovery.

DISCHARGE ADVICE
Tab Pantoprazole 40mg OD before breakfast for 10 days.
Tab Tramadol 50mg SOS for pain.
Surgical wound dressing review after 5 days.
